tables.name: waitlist_signups
tables.purpose: Stores each shopper's request to be notified when a specific item is back in stock.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: email
columns.purpose: Shopper email address — notification target; no account required

columns.name: item_external_id
columns.purpose: Variant external id for variant-level signups or product external id for product-level signups

columns.name: item_type
columns.purpose: Discriminator: variant or product, determines how item_external_id is interpreted

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: Always the product external id, used to cascade-delete all signups when the product is removed

columns.name: unsubscribe_token
columns.purpose: Cryptographically random token embedded in notification emails for one-click unsubscribe via the /unsubscribe GET route

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Lifecycle: pending (waiting for restock), notified (included in a batch), unsubscribed, deleted

columns.name: signed_up_at
columns.purpose: Preserves FIFO queue order when selecting the front-of-queue batch to notify

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.purpose: Set when the parent product is deleted; null means active

tables.name: notification_batches
tables.purpose: Records each restock event and tracks which signups were selected for notification, preventing duplicate blasts per restock cycle.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: item_external_id
columns.purpose: The variant or product external id that restocked

columns.name: item_type
columns.purpose: Discriminator: variant or product

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: Parent product external id; used for cascade-delete

columns.name: restock_date_bucket
columns.purpose: Calendar date string (YYYY-MM-DD) of the restock event, combined with item_external_id as the dedup key so repeated webhook fires on the same day for the same item are treated as one restock cycle

columns.name: signups_selected
columns.purpose: Number of signups included in this batch

columns.name: emails_sent
columns.purpose: Running count of emails successfully dispatched

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Lifecycle: pending (batch created, not yet dispatched), running (dispatch in progress), completed, failed

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.purpose: Set when the parent product is deleted

tables.name: notification_sends
tables.purpose: Junction table linking a notification batch to each individual signup that received an email, enabling per-shopper delivery tracking and dedup checks.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: batch_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES notification_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: The notification_batch that triggered this send

columns.name: signup_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_signups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: The waitlist_signup that was notified

columns.name: sent_at
columns.purpose: Null until the email platform confirms dispatch

columns.name: status
columns.purpose: Lifecycle: pending, sent, failed

tables.name: conversions
tables.purpose: Records when a notified shopper purchases the item they were waiting for within the attribution window, powering the lost-demand-recovered metric.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: The paid order that triggered the conversion check

columns.name: signup_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES waitlist_signups(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: The waitlist_signup that converted

columns.name: item_external_id
columns.purpose: The item that was purchased

tables.name: demand_stats_snapshots
tables.purpose: Pre-aggregated per-item demand metrics refreshed after each notification batch completion and each conversion, enabling instant-load admin dashboard.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal id

columns.name: item_external_id
columns.purpose: The variant or product external id being summarised

columns.name: item_type
columns.purpose: Discriminator: variant or product

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: Parent product external id for grouping and cascade-delete

columns.name: product_title
columns.purpose: Denormalized product title fetched from Shopify at snapshot refresh time; known-stale between refreshes (bounded by next batch completion or conversion event)

columns.name: variant_title
columns.purpose: Denormalized variant display name fetched at snapshot refresh time; null for product-level items

columns.name: waitlist_count
columns.purpose: Current number of pending signups

columns.name: total_signups
columns.purpose: All-time signups including notified and unsubscribed

columns.name: total_notified
columns.purpose: Total emails dispatched across all restock cycles

columns.name: total_conversions
columns.purpose: Total purchases attributed within conversion window

widget.purpose: Accept a shopper's email for a sold-out item and record the waitlist signup.
Check whether the current visitor's email is already signed up for a given item.
Unsubscribe a shopper from all their waitlists using a token from their notification email.

admin.purpose: Return the ranked waitlist demand summary — products sorted by waitlist size.
Return a paginated list of individual subscribers for a given product or variant.
Stream a CSV export of all subscribers for a given product or variant.
Return the current merchant notification settings.
